user.title: TripShot transit system
user.description: Choose the transit system to track. Only public timetable and bus-position data is read; no sign-in is required or possible.

route.title: Route
route.description: Choose the line to track on {instance}.

settings.title: Adherence settings
settings.description: A bus counts as arriving on time if it arrives within the early buffer before its scheduled arrival, and as departing on time if it leaves within the late buffer after its scheduled departure. These apply to every stop on the route. The timezone must be the transit system's own — timetable times and the service day are local to the buses, not to Home Assistant.

data.timezone: Transit system timezone — the timezone the BUSES run in, not where Home Assistant is. Defaults to Home Assistant's.
data.measurement_grace_sec: Measurement grace (seconds) — tolerance on the strict side of both windows. Leave at -1 to follow the poll interval automatically (recommended); a value of 0 or more is used exactly as given.
data.confirm_polls: Consecutive polls that must agree before a geofence crossing counts. Set 1 to act on the first poll (no debouncing); 2 ignores a bus flickering across the boundary. The crossing is timestamped at the first poll that saw it either way, so this costs no accuracy.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TripShot API.
error.unknown_instance: That transit system is no longer listed.
error.unknown_route: That route is no longer listed.
error.invalid_timezone: Not a recognised timezone name. Use an IANA name such as America/New_York.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TripShot API.

abort.no_routes: This transit system advertises no public routes today.
abort.already_configured: This transit system and route are already configured.
